answer: To keep replica keys from multiplying votes, the economy grants no standing until a newcomer locks a refundable bond in a common lagoon of escrow and then completes paid jobs for eight distinct counterparties. Each job must settle on a public river of receipts, with at least one epoch between any two of those counterparties, and no two newcomers may share more than one of the same counterparties in that window. A slowly grown juniper of endorsements is slashed if the same work packet is reused by a second key, so cloning identities costs more time and collateral than one honest agent.
